stem:
At home in Pune, Aarav makes jaljeera by stirring mint paste, roasted cumin powder, salt, lemon juice and chilled water in a steel jug. The drink looks cloudy, and he can still taste the lemon and mint separately. No gas bubbles or new solid appear.

Which check best decides whether the jaljeera is a mixture?

options.text: It is a mixture only if the liquid becomes one even colour throughout.
It is a mixture only if the substances react and form a new substance.
It is a mixture because two or more substances are physically mixed and each keeps its own properties.
It is not a mixture because the separate tastes can still be noticed.

teacher.key_rationale: The decisive criterion is physical combination of two or more substances with each component retaining its properties; uniform appearance or chemical reaction is not required.
